about: Inkling-2-Mini (mlx-community/Inkling-2-Mini-oQ4e-mtp: NVFP4 layers 0-19 + affine 4-bit layers 20-23 + affine 8-bit attention/embed/head + BF16 DSpark MTP) on inkmax (zero-dependency Zig 0.17.1 + Metal 3.2/4 engine) at a 262,144-token (256K) window with Q4 global KV (gs=32) and adaptive lossless DSpark 7-draft speculative decoding on Apple M5 Ultra 256 GB. Single-MTLCommandBuffer draft + verify execution (200/200 bit-exact greedy parity via metal::precise::fma), page-aligned zero-copy mmap weight cache (15.14 GiB, ~283 ms warm start) + 2.25 GiB 256K Q4 full-attention KV + 0.04 GiB 40-visit sliding ring KV = ~17.5 GiB total footprint (scales to 1M context in 24.18 GiB).
install: git clone https://github.com/chillerno1/inkmax.git && cd inkmax && git checkout bd8ec38a2a5996ae95965b57b94500f0db6c70a6 && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast (macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon, Xcode Metal Toolchain xcrun metal, Zig 0.17.1)
setup: macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon (tested on Apple M5 Ultra, 64-core GPU, 256 GB unified memory), Xcode Command Line Tools + Metal Toolchain (xcrun metal), Zig 0.17.1. First start packs the safetensors shards into a page-aligned 15.14 GiB inkmax.weights file inside the model directory (stripping the 0.64 GB vision tower in text mode); subsequent starts zero-copy mmap it in ~283 ms. 262,144-token Q4 KV cache + weights takes ~17.5 GiB unified memory (no iogpu.wired_limit_mb change needed).
